tests_pass.note: bh-hud-test 62/0, physics, lint-precision, parity-gr re-run green; capture-bh 40 renders OK; bh-render-diff 0.000/255 x40. Full make test not rerun (executor green).

acceptance_criteria.note: AC-12, 14, 15 verified by command; AC-13 met in spirit (renders pinned by hash and bucket, not committed; diff is self-referential; sign-off pending).

code_quality.note: HUD built only from sim.gr (sentinel test moves every number); weak_k moved to physics mirror; Makefile .PHONY and make sim wiring correct. Only client-side derivations are approach pacing (not displayed).

documentation.note: Report, changelog fragment and sprint JSON present and mostly accurate; overstatements below.

design_fidelity.note: Title-screen entry skipped (optional); true Galactic-Centre sky deferred and captioned; ring latency and auto-exposure labelled rather than fixed.

findings.description: AC-13 says renders are 'committed'. Only the sha256 manifest is committed; PNGs are in the gitignored renders/ dir and the public bucket. The diff compares a capture to a baseline produced by the same code on the same machine (0.000/255 is guaranteed by determinism), so it is a regression pin, not independent validation. Only the executor (Opus) opened the renders; Mark's sign-off is pending (the report says so).
findings.suggested_fix: Word AC-13 as 'pinned by hash, served from the bucket'; keep sign-off pending until Mark opens them.

findings.description: The AC-13 command greps 'opened by' (case-sensitive), but the report writes 'Opened by', so the design's grep returns nothing. The AC-14 grep over tools/ also matches the Python oracle tools/geodesic_ref.py (lines 50, 195), which is allowed as an oracle but makes the literal command fail.
findings.suggested_fix: Use lower-case 'opened by' or grep -i; narrow the AC-14 grep to exclude the oracle (or allowlist it).

findings.description: Performance table is honest about the Metal GPU timer reading 0 and host load ~3.5, but it only shows a +2 ms Vulkan GPU cost hidden under a ~8.4 ms wall frame at a vsync-off cap. 'Laptop numbers unmeasured' is stated. Headroom claim is fine for this machine only; the 1-in-300 spike on Metal during orbit is not investigated.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the caveat; add a laptop run before any minimum-spec claim.

findings.description: Stars are drawn as seen from Sol while the ship sits at Sgr A* (OQ5). This is labelled by the HUD caption and the report, but the sky is physically inconsistent with the ship position by design; star parallax or ring stars are not those of the Galactic Centre.
findings.suggested_fix: Track the true Galactic-Centre sky as a follow-up item in the roadmap.

findings.description: Several checks compare the HUD text with hud_lines(sim.gr) from the same function (hud_has), which is tautological on its own. The sentinel checks with literal expected strings and the 'every number moves with its field' check cover this adequately.
findings.suggested_fix: Optional: add a literal-string check at the 3 r_s orbit stop from the real sim (the report quotes values such as static clock 0.816497).

findings.description: M3.5 gaps: ring-star latency (~0.6 s) is left unfixed and auto-exposure is bypassed (fixed manual exposure) rather than fixed. Both are labelled, which meets the 'fixed or labelled' scope.
findings.suggested_fix: None required; carry as known limits.
